title: Fppf quotient presentation of an algebraic-space groupoid
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $U,R$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] with groupoid maps $s,t,e,i,c$ satisfying [def-sfb-algebraic-space-groupoid]. Use categories over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, based functors, and vertical natural isomorphisms as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For such a category $F$ and a map $a:U\to F$, an fppf quotient presentation consists of: the groupoid laws; the fppf-stack condition on $F$ [def-sfb-fppf-stackification]; a vertical natural isomorphism $\eta:as\simeq at$; bijectivity of the induced map from arrows $r\in R(T)$ with specified source $x$ and target $y$ to vertical arrows $a(x)\to a(y)$, for every test scheme $T/S$; for every object $z$ over $T$, a covering sieve in the big fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site] on which $z$ admits arrows above the covering maps from objects $a(x)$; and compatibility $\eta(r);\eta(q)=\eta(c(q,r))$ for all composable arrows. Endpoint equalities are transported. These data present the fppf stackification $[U/R]$ up to equivalence and preserve its actual arrows and composition.
